_description: Successful project package patterns and layout intelligence for AI recommendations.

layout_planning_rules.note: Hybrid work (2–3 days/week in office) reduces desks needed by 20–30% vs headcount. Apply 70% ratio for hot-desking.

furniture_packages.label: Startup / Small Office
furniture_packages.recommended_series: mid-range workstation series with ergonomic chairs

furniture_packages.label: Professional Services Office
items: Workstations (consider sit-stand upgrade) x staff count
furniture_packages.finance_note: Offer Stratton Finance at quote stage

furniture_packages.label: Corporate Executive Office
items: Open-plan workstations (mix of sit-stand and fixed) x staff count
furniture_packages.finance_note: Lead with finance option — Stratton below $200k, QPF above

upsell_opportunities: Sit-stand desk upgrade: $400–$600 per desk uplift. 60–70% acceptance when framed as health investment.
Acoustic screens for workstations: $150–$350 per workstation. High ROI on productivity.
Phone booths / focus pods: $3,500–$8,000 each. Growing demand in hybrid work environments.
Delivery + installation: 15–25% of product value. Always include — protects margin and ensures quality.
Asset tagging: $500–$1,500 flat. Easy value-add for corporate clients.
